integrity: Theorem derived analytically. Standalone normalization and simulation checks were run; numerical evidence is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only full-rank Euclidean three-dimensional lattices, Haar-uniform population distances. Recovers Voronoi-relevant vector length multiset, not generally the torus isometry type; no finite-sample stability. Priority remains provisional owing to incomplete access to some broad distance-distribution literature.
title: Exact facet-jump spectrum of intrinsic distances on flat three-tori
